free_tier.stated: Free plan: 50K IP geolocation queries a month with an API key (plus 500 Domain WHOIS and 50 Hosted Domain queries), 11 IP attributes; keyless: 1,000 queries a day with no registration
free_tier.notes: the keyless quota resets at 00:00 UTC daily and is served from the US East region only

interface_detail: GET api.ip2location.io/?ip=IP&format=json, keyless or with key=KEY; JSON answer with country, region, city, coordinates, ZIP, time zone, ASN and a public-proxy flag
tooling: any HTTP client; vendor SDKs for PHP, Python, .NET and others
chaining: 1,000 keyless lookups a day with no account, or 50K a month with a free key; the LITE database (separate record) covers unmetered local lookups. Bulk path: none on the free API plan

limits.value: 50K queries a month with a free key; 1,000 a day keyless, reset at 00:00 UTC; the free plan stops when queries run out

identity_cost.detail: name, work email and password with an arithmetic question; one plan per email address; the keyless route needs nothing

reliability_note: the free plan stops answering when its queries run out (no overage); the keyless route is served from one US East region
confidence_note: the pricing page and the signup form were quoted on 2026-10-30, and a keyless lookup answered HTTP 200 naming its 1,000-a-day limit. No account was opened, so the 50K keyed quota is documented only.
